hero.title:
Your farm,

in real time.
hero.body: Growcast unifies silos, warehouses and crops in a single monitoring platform. Real-time data, from field to decision.
sensors.title: Your whole operation, one network.
sensors.body: Temperature, humidity, CO₂, conductivity and pH: every variable, at every point, streaming to a central core.
data.title: Raw data becomes structure.
data.body: Time series, thresholds and early alerts: every variable, ordered and ready to act on.
converge.title: It all converges in Growcast.
converge.body: We measure every variable, control irrigation and climate, and trace every batch — from sensor to decision, in a single source of truth.

sol.cultivo.title: Every room, under control.
sol.cultivo.lede: Climate, irrigation and nutrition monitoring and control for indoor grow rooms and greenhouses. One node per room, all rooms on one platform.
sol.cultivo.impl.1: One node per room: temperature, humidity, CO₂ and airflow.
sol.cultivo.impl.2: EC and pH probes in the irrigation solution.
sol.cultivo.impl.3: Irrigation, ventilation and climate control by thresholds and schedules.
sol.cultivo.solve.3: Early detection of deviations before they hit the crop.
sol.cultivo.solve.4: Batch traceability, from transplant to harvest.
sol.cultivo.figure: Room sensors → node → Growcast core → irrigation and climate actuators
sol.silos.title: Grain, watched around the clock.
sol.silos.lede: Grain temperature and moisture monitoring in silos, bins and silo bags, with automatic aeration and early spoilage alerts.
sol.silos.impl.1: Multipoint temperature and moisture probes inside the grain mass.
sol.silos.impl.2: Headspace CO₂ as an early spoilage indicator.
sol.silos.impl.3: Automatic fan control based on ambient conditions.
sol.silos.impl.4: History per silo and per batch, from your phone.
sol.silos.solve.1: Hot spots caught before they spread.
sol.silos.solve.2: Fewer losses to mould and insects.
sol.silos.solve.3: Aeration only when it pays: less energy, better grain.
sol.silos.solve.4: Stock and quality traceable per batch.
sol.silos.figure: Silo probes → node → Growcast core → fans
sol.maduracion.title: The same curve, every batch.
sol.maduracion.lede: Temperature, humidity and air-exchange control for cheese and cured-meat ripening rooms. Curves per product, records per batch.
sol.maduracion.impl.1: Temperature and relative-humidity sensors in every room.
sol.maduracion.solve.1: Repeatable curves: the same product, batch after batch.
sol.maduracion.solve.2: Fewer defects from mould and humidity swings.
sol.maduracion.figure: Room sensors → node → Growcast core → cooling and humidification
contact.title: Let's talk about your operation.
contact.body: Tell us what you want to monitor and we'll put together a tailored proposal: sensors, control and traceability on a single platform.
solutions.title: Three environments, one platform.
solutions.body: Grow rooms, silos and curing rooms: in every case we install the sensors, connect the controls and make everything visible from your phone or computer. No technical knowledge needed.
sol.step.1.title: We survey and install
sol.step.2.title: We measure and control
sol.step.3.title: We alert and record
sol.cultivo.who: Indoor growers, nurseries, greenhouses and propagation rooms.
sol.cultivo.step.1: We visit the site, define the measuring points per room and leave the nodes installed and connected.
sol.cultivo.step.2: Every room is visible in real time. Irrigation, ventilation and climate adjust themselves to the thresholds we set together.
sol.cultivo.step.3: If anything goes out of range, we alert you on WhatsApp. Everything is recorded per batch, from transplant to harvest.
sol.silos.who: Grain elevators, cooperatives and farmers with silos, bins or silo bags.
sol.silos.step.1: We survey the silos and place the probes inside the grain and the sensors in the headspace.
sol.silos.step.2: Grain temperature and moisture are visible silo by silo. Fans start and stop on their own when the weather is right.
sol.silos.step.3: On a hot spot we alert you instantly. The history of every silo and every batch is kept.
sol.maduracion.who: Cheese makers, cured-meat producers and plants with ripening or drying rooms.
sol.maduracion.step.1: We install sensors in every room and connect the cooling, humidification and air exchange.
sol.maduracion.step.2: We load each product's curve. The room follows it on its own, day by day, with no intervention.
sol.maduracion.step.3: Any deviation is alerted on WhatsApp. Every batch keeps its full record, ready for audits.
silo.aria: Diagram: probes inside the silo send temperature to the node, which reports to Growcast and drives the fan.
